line_items.work_text: Widening of 35 narrow roads of Guwahati city in the first phase

narrative: SEC directed GDD to prepare a Detailed Project Report for road widening and drainage activities and submit the proposal to Assam Infrastructure Financing Authority by 15th October 2013. SEC also directed UDD to submit status note on Uniform Building Bye-Laws and Health Department to submit status on compliance of directives.
